selection: All six settings, four policies, all148 setting-videos; no selection by current unified HOTA.
purpose: Assess whether paid observations identify whole-query/visual interactions modulo additive query-view and exact-context effects, without trusting lossy semantic parses.
row_nodes: Whole original query text and actual effective view, within each video and own policy.
column_nodes: Exact rendered visual digest, provided ID/frame, effective view, bbox and complete non-query prompt.
assumption: Additive row/column effects are a diagnostic subspace, not established true teacher bias or calibrated semantic probability.
requested_counts: 592 video-policy graphs; exact requests and identical query/context edges deduplicated separately.
limitations: Cycle dimensions are correlated contrasts, not independent semantic labels.
High interaction energy may reflect semantics, teacher noise, or view-specific coupling.
Zero residual on a tree means lack of identifiability, not teacher correctness.
No claim that removing additive components improves HOTA.
relation_to_primary_reference: Standard incidence projection; RMOT affinity interactions differ from errors in a single global ranking.
